description: This file defines the Reward class within the OpenCart admin module, responsible for sending reward notification emails to customers when they earn rewards. It handles loading dependencies, retrieving customer and store info, setting up email content, and queuing email tasks.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: A controller class in the admin mail namespace, responsible for handling reward email notifications to customers.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to prepare and queue an email notification about customer reward points. It retrieves customer, store, and language info, creates email content, and adds a mailing task.
